title: Community mate example
author: Scan64 contributors
description: One sound mate and one deliberately unsound legal continuation to demonstrate rejection.

lessons.title: Finish with the queen
hints: Keep the queen protected by your king.
lessons.explanation: Qg7 is mate: the queen covers the escape squares and the king protects g7.

lessons.title: Rejected stalemate example
lessons.explanation: Qe6 is legal but stalemates Black instead of winning. This lesson must be rejected.
